turns.text: I like those kinds of challenges.
Sometimes the most boring products need the most creative solutions.
turns.zh: 有时候最无聊的产品反而最需要创意十足的解决方案。

turns.text: You're going to fit in great here.
turns.zh: 你在这儿一定会融入得很好的。

turns.text: So, what do you like to do outside of work?
turns.zh: 那，工作之外你喜欢做些什么？

turns.text: I'm really into hiking and rock climbing.
turns.zh: 我特别喜欢徒步和攀岩。

turns.text: There are some great trails about an hour north of the city.
turns.zh: 城北大概一小时车程的地方有几条很棒的步道。
